buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Buyer Added Bid Specific Scope Of Work(SOW) Text Clause(s)

Scope of work :- In order to conduct survey work within the jurisdiction of this office located at Zoo Road, Itanagar , Arunachal Pradesh, for conveyance / transportation of surveyors, survey assistants, SDOs and survey equipment of this office alongwith representative of state Govt officials etc for survey of land in Arunachal Pradesh conducted in p hased manner or sometimes in urgent matter. Besides above other official field work is also required to be done fre quently or on day to day basis. 2. Specification : - SUV vehicle like Scropio SUV Model preferably with 4 Wheel Drive. 3. Additional terms and conditions : (a) The vehicles alongwith driver proposed to be hiredw ill remain in the consignee location, as the vehicle may be required for urgent surveys and other field work. Moreover, the duration for a particular sur vey depends upon the geographical features of area to be surveyed. For instance, survey for a remotest ar ea in Arunachal Pradesh may take maximum 10 to 20 days including the journey period which may vary. Us ually the surveys are conducted in phased manner and in certain cases surveys are also being done in urge nt cases. The vehicle required by this office on hire basis will normally have to make journeys to the locatio ns specified for the purpose falling under the jurisdiction of DEO Itanagar (Arunachal Pradesh). However, th e vehicle will also be required to travel anywhere as per the survey needs and will have to make journeys a t any hour of the day and night and on all days of the week, in all weather conditions, on all terrains (irresp ective of road condition), as per official needs. (b) The payment will be done on per Kms basis / running basis i.e, monthly package cost divided by Kms in monthly package as offered by the service provider. Therefore the bill/invoice must be calculated on Kms basis run for every month from the commencement of contract. Car dairy must be maintained which is required to be submitted alongwith the bill for verification and processing the payment through AAO Jorhat. (c) The vehicle offered should be in very good condition, properly furbished, any colour and should pref erably be not more than three year old from the date of manufacture. ( d) This invitation of rate is subject to the applicable Govt. policy on the matter and may be withdraw n at any stage of offer or contract if decided so by the concerned officer without giving any reason. The Age ncy/Owners offering their rates may please note that they will not be entitled to ask any explanation or cost etc. for such withdrawal of the notice/offer or contract at any stage. (e) In the event of the breakdown of the hired vehicle the service provider will get the same immediate ly repaired on his own expenditure to the satisfaction of DEO Itanagar or by a substitute. (f) The party/contractor supplying the vehicle will himself be responsible for safety of the hired vehicle safeguarding the same from loss, theft, vandalizing etc. This office will not be responsible for these things. (g) The vehicle supplied by the party must fulfill all applicable rules on motor vehicle/ pollution control/I nsurance/ Registration/ Proper certificate from the concerned Road Transport Officer for Roadworthiness to carry passengers, etc. The bidder will have to upload photocopies of vehicle registration certificate issued b y competent authority, insurance documents, tax paid certificate, driving license of the driver etc and comp liance to labour Law especially minimum wage, payment of PF, ESI etc. (h) The vehicle must be properly insured to cover all eventualities. The party/ contractor will be respons ible to make payment occurring out of accidents etc, compensation to the workmen, to the third party etc, the submission of the rate by the party will be sufficient to deem that the party has indemnified this office, UOI, the officers/staff of this office, from all liabilities arising out of this work/offer/contract. (i) The vehicle required by this office on hire basis will normally have to make journeys to the location s specified for the purpose falling under the jurisdiction of DEO Itanagar (Arunachal Pradesh). However, the vehicle will also be required to travel anywhere as per needs & requirement. (j) The vehicle must be made available to this office for all time of day & night and all days of the time period for which the vehicle is hired. The vehicle will have to make journeys at any hour of the day and nig ht and on all days of the week, in all weather conditions, on all terrains (irrespective of road condition), as p er official needs.

(k) The vehicle offered to this office on hire will not be given to any other individual/ party for any reas on whatsoever by the vehicle offering party/contractor during the hired period. (l) The party supplying the vehicle on hiring will have to bear all cost for maintaining and running the v ehicle hired by this office including the fuel/lubricants/salaries & allowances of the Driver etc. The party will be responsible for the payment of Taxes/Tolls/Chungi/fees, Charges etc. for maintaining and running the ve hicle on roads. (m) The party supplying the hired vehicle will also have to provide the Driver at his own expenses. The Salary, applicable uniform, daily allowances, overtime allowances etc. to the driver will be paid by the part y supplying the vehicle. The Driver provided by the party must possess valid commercial driving license/ILP issued by the competent authority. The Driver’s vision investigation report from qualified doctor should be s ubmitted in original to this office. (n) As the locations under the jurisdiction of DEO Itanagar, Arunachal Pradesh covers areas connected with good roads in thickly populated areas as well as very poorly maintained difficult roads in hilly, forested dirt terrains, the driver must have suitable experience and expertise to drive the vehicle in all conditions an d terrains. The party will have to provide details, police verification report of the driver along with his and d river’s three passport size color photographs and impression of driver’s fingers. (o) The name and description of the places, routes, structures visited etc. will never be divulged to any unauthorized person by the vehicle driver, the owner/party/contractor of the vehicle, not only during the pe ndency of hiring period but also all times after that. (p) The DEO Itanagar, Arunachal Pradesh can add more conditions and/or delete any of the conditions mentioned herein at any stage of offer/contract. The additional conditions added will also be binding along with the conditions mentioned herein on the contractor/party and the driver of the vehicle. They will have t o follow the all verbal and written directions of the DEO Itanagar, Arunachal Pradesh promptly and without f ail. (q) The party/contractor supplying the vehicle will have to maintain the vehicle in good condition to the satisfaction of DEO Itanagar, Arunachal Pradesh during the pendency of hiring period. (r). The contractor will have to bear expenditure and cost, if for his poor/negligent work/service/contract performance, this office has to suffer any loss or cost. The amount of such losses and costs will recovered f rom the party/contractor in a way as deemed fit by this office. (s). If the DEO Itanagar, Arunachal Pradesh finds that the contractor has failed to render satisfactory ser vice he may cancel the hiring of the vehicle with 1 month notice. (t) For other reasons the party can give a 1 month notice to cancel the contract. (u). The other terms and condition : As per GeM contract. ​​​​
